classification.difficultyReason: Use the known maximum and range to recover the minimum score, then translate that score into its missing units leaf. The short inverse chain requires two linked representation steps.

inlines.text: The stem-and-leaf plot represents the daily sales of soft drink from a vending machine.
If the range of sales is 43, what is the value of

spec.sourceRegion: Question 10, plot at the lower right of the question
spec.description: Stem-and-leaf plot with a horizontal rule above the data and a vertical stem/leaf divider. The first leaf is an italic bold N enclosed by a circle. No key is printed.
spec.mathematics: Stems 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 have leaves [N, 5, 5], [4, 7, 7, 9], [0, 5, 8], [2], [0, 7], respectively. The circled N is a single units digit in the value 20 + N.
spec.answerVisibility: All stems, numerical leaves and the circled N remain visible in the student question. The value of N and the supplied answer sentence occur only in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The greatest value is $67$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Range}&=\text{greatest value}-\text{least value}\\\text{Least value}&=67-43\\\text{Least value}&=24\end{align*}$$

The missing value is $2\mid N=24$, so the missing leaf is $N=4$.
